title.en: United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO)
title.hi: United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO)

definition.en: UNESCO is a specialized agency of the United Nations aimed at promoting world peace and security through international cooperation in education, arts, sciences, and culture.
definition.hi: UNESCO is a specialized agency of the United Nations aimed at promoting world peace and security through international cooperation in education, arts, sciences, and culture.

importanceInUpsc.en: For UPSC GS-3, UNESCO is significant due to its role in the creative economy, sustainable development goals, and the preservation of cultural heritage which impacts tourism and economic growth. Understanding its influence on policy frameworks helps in analyzing India's international commitments and soft power in the global economy.
